sources.entry: Docs - Collaborative note taking, wiki and documentation platform that scales. (Source Code) MIT K8S

summary.one_liner: La Suite Docs is an open-source, self-hostable collaborative text editor and wiki for real-time team note-taking, knowledge organization, and document sharing.
summary.what_it_does: Docs provides a rich-text and Markdown editor with slash commands and blocks, plus real-time collaboration with live cursors, comments, sharing, and granular access control. Documents can be organized into subpages and hierarchies and searched by content. A presentation mode builds slides from `---` delimiters, with full-screen, keyboard navigation, and PDF export. Import supports .docx and .md, and export supports .docx, .odt, and .pdf. Optional AI helpers (rewrite, summarize, translate, fix typos) are model- and gateway-agnostic and need only an API key and URL. It also exposes a resource server API and a server-to-server API for integrations, such as pushing Meet meeting transcripts into Docs.
use_cases: building an internal wiki or knowledge base
self-hosted alternative to Notion or Google Docs
exporting documents to PDF, DOCX, or ODT
how_to_run: Self-hosting: follow the installation guide (Kubernetes or Docker Compose are supported; Nix and YunoHost are community-provided)
Local development: install Docker, Docker Compose, and GNU Make
Open the local app and log in with the development-only credentials (impress / impress)
notable: Real-time collaboration built on Yjs and BlockNote.js
Presentation mode generated from `---` delimiters with PDF export
Optional AI writing features that are model and gateway agnostic, including a V2 AI toolbar and AI cursor (beta)
Server-to-server API that lets Meet push meeting transcripts into Docs
Developed by French (DINUM) and German (ZenDiS) government initiative
caveats: Some features such as PDF export rely on GPL-licensed BlockNote XL packages that are not MIT-compatible; building with PUBLISH_AS_MIT=true omits them
The local development setup is intended for development and testing only
The AI cursor feature is marked as beta
